capacity:events.title: Carrier events can't keep up
capacity:events.message: At the diagram's own rates (sources without a rate send 2/s), it gets 30/s and handles 20/s (150%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:events.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.
